profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ UiPath | Agents, LLM
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer at UiPath with 10+ years of experience specializing in AI/LLM integration, agent-based systems, and zero-to-one product development. Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams to deliver innovative AI solutions from concept to production, including architecting guardrails frameworks and tools infrastructure that directly enhance user trust and platform adoption.
Core Expertise:
	•	AI/LLM Integration: OpenAI GPT, prompt engineering, embedding systems, AI-powered search
	•	Technical Leadership: Leading multi-developer teams, mentoring, architecture design
	•	Zero-to-One Development: Taking features from POC through design to GA release on aggressive timelines
	•	Platform Engineering: Microservices, Kubernetes, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure (Azure)
	•	Full-Stack Development: React, TypeScript, NextJS, Node.js, Python
Key Impact: Reduced Documentation project delivery by 25%, doubled case deflection rates through AI integration, and architected core agent platform infrastructure serving thousands of users.

projects.title: Search Engine
projects.description: Used Java, MVC, and information retrieval technologies to develop search engine with advanced indexing, four different ranking algorithms, and encoding technique for memory reduction.
